card.name: Small words before transplant-rejection terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "in", "after" or "receiving" in transplant drug labels, where the next words are likely rejection, graft, organ or transplant.

modes.label: Risk of rejection
modes.description: The word "of" after "risk" where rejection or graft loss is expected next.

modes.example: prophylaxis of organ rejection<< in>> patients receiving renal transplants.

modes.label: After transplant
modes.example: new onset diabetes mellitus<< after>> transplant.
